verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents a built-in 'Payroll AI' that takes on specific work: it collects time and attendance data, flags inconsistencies, and texts the admin with updates. That is the product's own AI handling tasks for the user. The evidence is a single marketing line covering a narrow, proactive workflow, not a general assistant the user can hand arbitrary tasks to. missing for 10: an interactive assistant that accepts user-initiated requests, delegation beyond time/attendance collection, in-depth docs on what the AI can do, independent or hands-on corroboration.
